details:
What does it do and how does it work?
Orbital Project is an interactive 3D planetary and orbital simulator powered by real NASA open data and Nova, an integrated humanoid AI mission assistant. Available both as a web-based control console and a full-immersion Virtual Reality experience compatible with the Omni One omnidirectional treadmill, the platform allows users to explore Solar System bodies—such as Earth, Saturn, Titan, and Enceladus—in real time. Players design custom spacecraft probes, configure scientific payloads (such as Mass Spectrometers and Multispectral Cameras), manage mission resources (energy, mass, budget, and time), and test survival gear against real atmospheric and climate telemetry.

What benefits does it have?

  • Accessible STEM Education: It transforms complex Keplerian orbital mechanics and raw space agency datasets into an intuitive, gamified experience.
  • Interactive Decision-Making: Instead of passively reading static charts, students, researchers, and enthusiasts actively evaluate temperature, radiation, pressure, and habitability constraints before launching a virtual expedition.
  • Collaborative Learning: Through solo and multiplayer modes, players work alongside Nova—who adapts to their strategy and offers real-time clues—fostering communication, teamwork, and critical thinking

What is the intended impact of the project?
Our core goal is to bridge the gap between raw NASA datasets and hands-on space exploration, inspiring the next generation of scientists, engineers, and explorers. Furthermore, we want to demonstrate that the future of technology is not about machines replacing humans, but about humans collaborating with each other and with AI to solve complex problems we could never tackle alone.

What tools, coding languages, hardware, or software did you use?

  • Data Sources: NASA Open Data, NASA JPL orbital trajectories, NASA Earthdata, NASA Worldview, and Observatorio Naval Buenos Aires.
  • Hardware Integration: Designed for standard web browsers/consoles as well as VR headsets and the Omni One 360-degree omnidirectional treadmill.
  • Development & Design Stack: Unity / Unreal Engine / Three.js, React, JavaScript, Python, Figma, HeyGen for Nova's AI avatar

How is your project creative & what factors did your team consider?
Our project stands out by blending hard scientific accuracy with immersive storytelling, physical VR movement, and a relatable AI companion (Nova). When designing Orbital Project, our team carefully balanced scientific realism (true planetary gravity, atmospheric composition, and orbital physics) with user experience (UX) and accessibility, ensuring that anyone—regardless of their technical background—can step into a spacecraft cockpit, understand the engineering trade-offs of spaceflight, and experience the thrill of planetary discovery.
